parsed.text: This packet contains location-distribution data for red and blue roles on 4x4 local grids in panels p0 and p1. Current views (represented times provided in the packet) show identical patterns in both panels: at node n0 blue mass concentrates on the four top-right cells ([0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]) while red mass concentrates on the four top-left cells ([0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]); nodes n1–n3 are uniform for both roles. Candidate command records are conditional, not executed events; copied prior records are inherited, not new estimates. Across candidates: k0 reproduces the n0 concentration matching the current pattern; k1 is uniform everywhere; k2 represents a sharp conditional concentration at n0 with blue peaking at [0,2] and red peaking at [0,0] (single-cell peaks with much larger peak probabilities than the current four-cell peaks); nodes n1–n3 remain uniform under all candidates.
